spain.title: Flag of Spain

colors.note: Represents generosity; the central band is twice the width of each red stripe

desc: - Three horizontal stripes — red, yellow (double width), and red — known as 'La Rojigualda'
- The state flag bears the national coat of arms on the yellow stripe
trivia:
- The coat of arms shows the heraldic lions of Castile and the crowns of Aragon and Granada
- The red and gold are the historic colours of Spain dating to medieval times
- Spain's flag remains relatively unchanged since 1785
